runs.name: launch-ready
runs.cmd: export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=$PWD/gitconfig GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 && cd shoreline && git init -q -b main && git add . && git commit -q -m 'Shoreline Crew HQ: the course code' && git remote add origin https://github.com/sam-rivera/shoreline.git && mkdir -p shoreline-hq/.netlify && echo '{"siteId": "demo"}' > shoreline-hq/.netlify/state.json && node ../launch_check.mjs

runs.name: launch-not-a-repo
runs.cmd: export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=$PWD/gitconfig GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 && cd shoreline && node ../launch_check.mjs
expect: FIX   the course folder is not a Git repository yet

runs.name: launch-before-the-lesson
runs.cmd: export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=$PWD/gitconfig GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 && cd shoreline && git init -q -b main && git add . && git commit -q -m 'Shoreline Crew HQ: the course code' && node ../launch_check.mjs

runs.name: launch-secret-committed
runs.cmd: export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=$PWD/gitconfig GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 && cd shoreline && echo 'VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:4000' > shoreline-hq/.env.local && git init -q -b main && git add . && git commit -q -m 'Shoreline Crew HQ: the course code' && git add -f shoreline-hq/.env.local && git commit -q -m 'oops' && node ../launch_check.mjs
expect: FIX   shoreline-hq/.env.local is in the repository
